name: Grand River
gaugeName: GRAND RIVER AT COUNTY HWY H NEAR KINGSTON, WI
blurb: Grand River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.putIn: Hwy H and Grand River Landing
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: The named take-out is downstream of Grand River Marsh Dam. A legal, usable carry around the dam is unresolved; the refuge also has seasonal access restrictions.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Grand River Marsh and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

notices.title: Dam crossing and seasonal refuge restrictions
notices.text: This section ends below Grand River Marsh Dam; a usable portage has not been established. DNR closes the designated wildlife refuge to entry September 1–November 30. Main Dam Road has seasonal gate access. Check the property map and current conditions before visiting.
